en.name: Breast Reconstruction
en.meta_title: Breast Reconstruction Surgery: Restoring Shape After Mastectomy
en.meta_description: Explore options for breast reconstruction surgery after a mastectomy. Learn about implant-based and autologous (flap) reconstruction to restore breast shape, appearance, and your sense of self with compassionate, expert care.
en.meta_keywords: breast reconstruction, post-mastectomy reconstruction, implant reconstruction, flap reconstruction, DIEP flap, breast cancer surgery, restorative surgery

what_is.heading: What is Breast Reconstruction? Restoring Wholeness
paragraphs: Losing a breast to mastectomy can be a deeply emotional part of the cancer journey. Breast reconstruction is a series of procedures designed to restore the shape, appearance, and size of the breast, helping a woman feel whole again and move forward with confidence.

options.heading: Advanced Reconstruction Options
paragraphs: At LUNAI, our compassionate and skilled surgeons offer a range of advanced breast reconstruction options. Reconstruction can be performed at the same time as the mastectomy (immediate reconstruction) or at a later date (delayed reconstruction). The two main approaches are implant-based reconstruction and autologous (or "flap") reconstruction, which uses your own body tissue from the abdomen, back, or thighs to create a new breast mound. The best option depends on your body type, cancer treatment plan, and personal preference.

our_approach.heading: A Compassionate and Personalized Journey
paragraphs: We will work closely with you and your oncology team to create a safe and effective surgical plan. Breast reconstruction is a highly personal journey, and our goal is to support you every step of the way. We aim to create a result that not only looks natural but also helps restore your sense of self and femininity after breast cancer.
